track: The Open Gate II - The Garden Within
voice_direction: mature male, warm, low, unhurried, near-monotone, intimate; speed ~0.85; let ellipses breathe

segments.text: This program is hypnotic in nature... and is created for relaxation, and personal growth. Never listen in a moving vehicle... or at any time when you need your full, awakened attention.

For if every good thing must first be earned... if a gift finds you counting its cost... if a compliment slides off you... like rain off old stone... while you labor twice as long... for what others simply... receive...
...then this is your time to sit, or lie back, more comfortably relaxed.
And you already know the way... back along the dew-soft path... at first light... the world turning slowly gold... toward the garden... that has been waiting for you...
The old stone wall... warm with a thousand summers... roses gone wild along its length... and the iron gate... standing open now... just wide enough... for you...
And as you step inside... dew like scattered pearls beneath your feet... herbs waking in their rows... the whole garden... turning gently... to face you...
For this is the garden within... the one that grows... whether you tend it or not... the one that has been growing... for you... all along...
And as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you may notice the first light... softening... spreading... until it rests on every leaf... like a hand... on a shoulder...
Birdsong... drifting farther and farther away... dew... glinting... stilling...
And with each easy breath... you settle deeper... into the soil of this garden... where nothing needs to be earned... and nothing needs to be proved...
For your inner, wiser self... has kept this garden always... through every season of your life... watering what you forgot... keeping it all... for you...
And here... inside the garden within... everything grows... not because you earned it... but because it is yours...
For the sun never asks the garden... what it has done... to deserve the morning...
And the rain falls... on the tended rows... and the wild roses... alike...
You may notice... a fruit tree by the wall... its branches leaning toward you... offering... what it has made...
Perhaps... for once... you simply reach out... and take... what is offered...
For receiving is not a debt... it is a season... and this... is your season...
A gift arrives... and you let it in... the way the soil... lets in the rain...
A compliment... warms you... like light on a leaf... and stays...
For the garden keeps no ledger... no account... of what you owe...
And you might be pleasantly surprised... how much has been growing for you... while you were busy... earning...
The well in the corner... fills without being asked... and so... do you...
Each kindness you allow... takes root... and becomes... a perennial...
For you are not a guest in this garden... you are its keeper... and its heir...
And what is given to you... is not a loan... it is a harvest... long planted...
You need not repay the morning... only receive it...
The gate swings inward now... and good things walk through... as if they belonged...
For worthiness is not built... it is remembered... like a path... beneath the dew...
And every gift you say yes to... teaches the garden... to grow a little greener...
For you have always been the gardener... and the garden... has always grown... for you...
And now... as the morning brightens... you can bring something back with you...
For what grows in the garden within... was never earned... only allowed... only received...
And when a gift arrives, from this day forward... you accept it.
When a compliment is offered... you let it land.
When good comes to your gate... you open.
When gratitude rises... you follow it.
Each day the garden grows greener... each gift... more at home with you...
For you are... the gardener of your own receiving... and the gate... was never locked.
